title: Open Banking API Rate Limiter Misconfiguration — Third-Party Provider Lockout

content.summary: A misconfigured rate limiter on the Open Banking API on 2024-05-01 set the per-TPP (Third-Party Provider) limit to 10 requests/minute instead of 10 requests/second, effectively locking out all registered TPPs for 76 minutes and blocking PSD2-compliant payment initiations.

timeline.event: Scheduled rate-limiter config update deployed as part of PSD2 compliance enhancement
TPPs begin receiving HTTP 429 Too Many Requests on first legitimate API call
Three TPP partners raise P1 incidents with their bank contacts
Platform team identifies rate limiter unit mismatch (requests/minute vs requests/second)
Config corrected and deployed; TPP access restored
All TPP error rates return to baseline; incident resolved

content.root_cause: The rate limiter configuration file used a field named 'limit' which was interpreted as requests-per-minute by the new rate limiter version (v2.0) but had been requests-per-second in v1.x. The upgrade changelog documented this breaking change but the deployment engineer did not consult the migration guide. The value of 10 was not changed during the upgrade, causing a 60x reduction in effective throughput.
contributing_factors: Rate limiter upgrade changelog not reviewed before deploying configuration change
No integration test covering TPP authentication and rate limit behaviour
Deployment window was 06:00 UTC — outside business hours, reducing response speed

impact.psd2_compliance_breach: Potential — PSD2 requires banks not to obstruct TPP access; under review by Open Banking team

immediate: Revert rate limiter configuration to v1.x semantics
Notify all TPP partners of restoration
short_term: Add TPP rate limit smoke test to deployment pipeline (JIRA OB-120)
Document rate limiter unit change in internal API runbook RUN-008 (JIRA OPS-2240)
Schedule PSD2 access compliance review with Open Banking team (JIRA OB-121)
long_term: Introduce canary deployments for all API gateway configuration changes
Implement TPP health dashboard to surface lockout conditions within 60 seconds
